A learning kit for an AI agent to write a company's hints from its past TFLs

Source: R/ai_style.R
tfl_ai_style_prompt.Rd

Writes what an AI agent needs to learn how a company's past reports are made, by the kind of report, and to write it down as the company's hints (tflspec#547): R's numbers of the reports' look (learn/scan.csv, tfl_rtf_style_scan(); learn/tables.csv, one row a table, tfl_rtf_style_tables()) and the prompt (AGENTS-learn.md). The agent opens a few files of each kind for what R cannot read – the statistics and their labels, the n (%) and header N forms, the decimals, the sort, the footnotes' wording – and writes the conventions it found, a kind at a time, with how many of the files it read show each, to company_hints.yml. The file is kept beside the company standard, never merged into it: every study prepared for an agent afterwards gets a copy, and its agent takes a hint where the shell, the SAP, the study's documents and the company standard say nothing, before its general knowledge. tfl_ai_style_read() shows it as a table. Nothing is sent anywhere; the files and what is learned stay in the folder.

Usage

tfl_ai_style_prompt(rtf_dir = NULL, dir = NULL, standard = NULL)

Arguments

rtf_dir

The folder of the past RTF reports (a subfolder a study). NULL: past_tfl/ in dir.

dir

The company's AI folder. NULL: the option tflspec.ai_home, else ai/ of tflspec's data folder.

standard

The company standard's conventions, or NULL for none: a data frame with kind, key and value (kind all for every kind), as tfl_ai_style_diff() takes it. Given, it is written to learn/standard.csv, and the agent writes no hint for a point the standard says: where the past TFLs differ from it, it lists the point under conflicts:.

Value

The prompt (a tfl_ai_text), with the files' paths in its attribute files (prompt, scan, tables, standard – NA when none –, result).

Details

The folder is the company's AI folder (dir; default the option tflspec.ai_home, else ai/ of tflspec's data folder, tools::R_user_dir(); tflplanner sets it to ai/ of its home): past_tfl/ (the past RTF reports, a subfolder a study: the person puts them there), AGENTS-learn.md, learn/ and company_hints.yml.

See also

tfl_ai_style_read(), tfl_ai_style_diff()
